_comment: Owner queue D13 (9 Nov 2026). Compose 1.12 / Material 3 1.4 draw the dim behind sheets and dialogs 4-6 % lighter than Compose 1.7 / Material 3 1.3 in Robolectric (per-channel difference at most 16 levels, never more, no layout change: measured over 140 renders). Window dim is platform behaviour that cannot be pinned from app code; verify on a device (OWNER_QUEUE M4). The tolerance applies ONLY to these overlay screens and ONLY up to 'level' per channel; any larger difference still fails.
